title: Explicit hypercover and injective-resolution comparison for Grothendieck coefficients
statement: Let X be qcqs and A a Grothendieck abelian coefficient category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. For each finite split etale hypercover U [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover], form the section bicomplex of an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and its first-quadrant total complex [def-sp-double-complex-total]. If the augmented alternating section complex of every injective sheaf on every such hypercover is a quasi-isomorphism, the resolution augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism. The bottom inclusion, inverse augmentation on cohomology, and classical right-derived identification define comparisonNat U q from alternating section cohomology to the q-th derived terminal sections. For each refinement f:U→V, cohomologyRefinement f q followed by comparisonNat U q equals comparisonNat V q.

proof.text: Construct the section complex functor and its terminal-section augmentation, proving the degree-zero cocycle equation by cancellation of the two face restrictions.

Construct the resolution bicomplex and both chain maps: the augmentation from terminal sections of the resolution and the bottom inclusion of the sheaf section complex. The resolution differential and section augmentation equation prove the chain-map identities.
Apply the first-quadrant column augmentation theorem to the assumed injective-row quasi-isomorphisms.

Define the cohomology comparison by the homology inverse of this augmentation and InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj. Prove naturality in sheaf morphisms from resolution descents; prove compatibility with refinements from the two augmentation squares and cancel the invertible homology augmentation.

lean.statement:
lemma comparisonNat_refinement
    (hrow : ∀ (U : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover X)
      (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A),
      Injective F → QuasiIso (sectionAugmentation A U F))
    {U V : FiniteSplitEtaleHypercover X} (f : U.Refinement V) (q : ℕ) :
    cohomologyRefinement A f q ≫ comparisonNat A hrow U q =
      comparisonNat A hrow V q
